title: ODGS Semantic Certificate (S-Cert)
description: Normative JSON Schema for a Semantic Certificate (S-Cert) generated by an ODGS-conformant runtime enforcement system (Level 1 Core and Level 2 Attested profiles).

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier (UUID v4) for this evaluation event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the evaluation event.

process_urn.description: URN of the governed process context in which evaluation occurred.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the executable constraint that was evaluated.

semantic_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the verbatim legislative or rulebook source text backing the evaluated rule.

verdict.description: Deterministic outcome of the runtime evaluation.

system_id.description: Identifier of the evaluating system instance.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the data payload state at the time of evaluation. Raw payload data is never included.

correlation_id.description: Optional cross-participant transaction or contract-agreement identifier linking the S-Cert to an upstream Trusted Data Transaction or W3C ODRL agreement.

jws_signature.description: Compact JWS signature (RFC 7515) over the canonical S-Cert payload. Required for Level 2 (Attested) conformance.

authority_id.description: Identifier of the Plane II attestation authority. Required for Level 2 conformance.

issuing_jwk_url.description: HTTPS URL of the JWK Set (RFC 7517) containing the public key used to verify jws_signature. Required for Level 2 conformance.
